A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' that lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had multiple members served as [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biology and appearance==
These [[Species/Legends|species]] had green or mint colored skin and had brown or green colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They also had cone-like [[Bone/Legends|skull]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
These species first appeared in [[Spy Girls]] which was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />
